description: Ask one of the hub's models for a completion, paid from your balance at the listed price. Metered on the tokens actually used: the ceiling is held first and the unspent part comes back, and a call that fails costs nothing. Streaming is REST only.

idempotencyKey.description: your key for this request; send it again on a retry and the charge is made once

max_tokens.description: the most the answer may be; the ceiling that is held. Default 4096.

name: call_model
